criteria.rationale: Examined the assumption that memoized results depend only on operation-frozen reads. Runs, attestations, transcript checks and bundle headers first consume the read view; keys distinguish root, producer, project and relevant filter or digest. Lifecycle refusals and producer attribution have regression coverage. The harne8 timing figures are implementer measurements, not independently repeated here. Remaining Git latency is explicitly tracked by spec follow-ups F1/F2.

sync.Map publishes one typed cell per key and sync.Once serializes computation. begin/end joins memo consumers to view finalization. Concurrent misses and finalized-view refusals are covered. No new background worker or cancellation lifecycle is introduced.
Reader signatures and persisted schemas remain unchanged. Deep copies preserve nested values and nil/empty shapes; transcript and header refusal paths retain visible failures.

Existing bounded readers and validation remain in the computation closures. Memo errors propagate; finalized transcript reads return an inspection problem and finalized header reads return LossReadError.
Reviewed review-verification and federated callers. The memo belongs to their existing governance operation and does not replace trust, authorization, or final-audit checks.
Loss details and transcript diagnostic strings remain visible, including memo lifecycle refusals. Producer-specific keys preserve final-audit attribution for every consuming producer.
Examined exported reader results, ledger formats, filtering and failure projections. No CLI, MCP or file-format migration is needed. Copy isolation and empty-result compatibility have explicit tests.

Reviewed all nine registered memo regression tests and their production paths. They cover reuse, fresh-read equivalence, operation-free reads, concurrent computation, nested copies, unexported fields, finalization, refusals and attribution.

D1 and ADR D14 address repeated parsing and hashing inside an operation whose reads already freeze the inputs. Keeping derived values in that operation removes repeated work while preserving first-read closure and audit coverage. Reviewed the three structural deltas against the scope's requirements and decision.

mappings.rationale: Validation-matrix changes retain deterministic integration coverage for equivalence and the surrounding Git snapshot behavior used by review operations.
ADR amendment D14 records the operation-scoped derived-value memo, its causal performance evidence, audit preservation and prohibition on cross-operation reuse.
The required review-ledger integration check registers counting, concurrency, isolation, lifecycle and attribution regressions for the read-once requirement.

criteria.rationale: Compared the spec, ADR D14, code comments and matrix test selector with runtime behavior. The spec explicitly qualifies reuse per producer, documents operation-only lifetime and preserves existing contracts. Its Git-performance follow-ups remain separate from delivered memo behavior.

Examined loss reporting, finalized-view errors and audit attribution. Refused reads cannot silently become intact transcripts or absent bundle headers. Existing record context remains available for diagnosis.

R1 is covered by computation counts and concurrent misses; R2 by transcript computation counts; R3 by operation-free repeated reads; R4 by fresh-read equivalence, copy isolation, lifecycle refusals and audit attribution. The operation freezes transcript metadata, so omitting a separately varying size from the memo key does not change the result within that operation.

The implementation matches the eight declared artifacts and D1's operation-local scope. The broader commit range includes separately governed Git-budget and doctor work; inspected the later snapshot/cleanup changes and found no alteration to ledger memo semantics.

Examined root/project/producer separation, first-read authorization, existing symlink and size checks, transcript digest validation and final audit. The memo grants no authority and bypasses no initial read. Values cannot be served after view finalization.

A small operation-owned map with one sync.Once cell per derived result is sufficient for repeated parsing and hashing. It avoids a new resident cache, persistence format or invalidation protocol. Deep copies and producer-specific computation are necessary for result isolation and audit attribution. The choice would need reconsideration if computations gained non-view inputs or operation reads stopped freezing their dependencies.
